result.title: DuoWM:Integrating Dual 6-DoF Visual Flows into Action-Conditioned Drone World Model
result.summary: Action-conditioned video world models generate future observations from an initial frame and a camera trajectory, but often fail to align camera commands with visual dynamics or represent full 6-DoF scene transformations. We present DuoWM, a first-person drone video world model with two complementary visual conditions. Action flow projects future camera positions and orientations into each target frame, while Object flow forward-warps the initial observation and overlays local 6-DoF transformations to ground the induced scene motion. We further introduce transform-aware pretraining, which pairs object appearance with explicit transformation axes before standard RGB video training. On Sekai-drone dataset, DuoWM achieves the best results across video quality, 3D consistency, and trajectory following. Compared with Captain Safari, the state-of-the-art method, our approach reduces real-domain FVD and LPIPS by 17.2\% and 21.6\%, respectively, while improving game-domain AUC@30 from 0.5003 to 0.5719 and AUC@15 from 0.3088 to 0.3747.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DuoWM，一个第一人称无人机视频世界模型：用「动作流」把未来相机位姿投影到目标帧，用「物体流」对初始观测做前向 warp 并叠加局部 6-DoF 变换，再加变换感知预训练，在 Sekai-drone 上改善视频质量、3D 一致性与轨迹跟随。
AI.relevance_reason: 双路几何条件（相机动作流 + 物体流）与变换感知预训练，可能为 LVR 中如何把任务必要的几何状态注入并监督 latent 表示提供可核查线索；但该文面向未来观测生成而非推理状态更新，迁移性需自行判断。
